If you want the idea fast, watch Caleb Writes Code's seven-minute explainer first. If you want to build, watch Greg Isenberg's conversation about using Jev for classification next. This page ranks and groups the 14 videos about TypeSafe's Jev worth your time, with each one embedded so you can watch here.

Jev launched on September 15, 2026, and the video response was immediate. We found roughly 370 videos published in the first five days that mention Jev in the title or description, and the biggest single video passed 350,000 views. Most of those are reaction clips. The ones below explain, teach, test or push back.
October 2026 update: the most-watched Jev videos now

How we picked these videos

We searched YouTube through a search API for Jev and TypeSafe terms, kept videos published in the first week, and ranked by view count as of September 20, 2026. Then we removed clips that were only reactions, videos where Jev was a passing mention, and non-English videos, because we cannot judge their accuracy. View counts move fast in launch week, so treat every number here as a snapshot.

We describe each video from its title and description, and we say so where the framing matters. We have not audited every claim in every video. Where a title overstates what Jev does, we flag it. If you spot an error in one of our notes, tell us and we will fix it.

What the videos leave out
Most launch videos show one impressive demo and stop. Four things are worth knowing before you build.

Jev's confidence score is what makes a confidence-gated cascade possible. In our own test across 791 labeled decisions, accuracy on the items Jev was at least 90 percent sure about was 95.5 percent on an 8-way routing task, against 83.8 percent overall. A confidence gate that sends the uncertain items to a larger model is a better plan than trusting every answer. ManasFlow has not used Jev on client work, so these are benchmark results, not client outcomes.

The cost story is real but smaller than the headlines when you compare like for like. On short prompts we measured Jev at 40 to 49 times cheaper than a frontier model per decision, and 4.7 to 7.5 times cheaper than the two cheapest small models, not hundreds of times. Median latency was 0.33 seconds against 0.67 to 1.17 seconds for the four models we tested. The raw results are public in the benchmark files.

Jev can be confidently wrong when your labels overlap. In our test all five of its most confident 8-way mistakes were the same pair of intents, and a larger model made the same call. That is a labeling problem, and a confidence score cannot fix it.
Numbers in demos are the builder's own claims. Our index of 1,300+ Jev builds marks them that way and includes the tests where Jev fell short, so you can see the limits as well as the wins.

FAQ
Is there an official Jev launch video?

Not on YouTube that we could find. A YouTube search on October 24, 2026 showed no launch video from an official TypeSafe channel; the widely shared launch-week videos are from independent creators such as Rob Shocks, Greg Isenberg and Matthew Berman. IBM Technology's "What Is Jev?" is now the most-viewed explainer we found, at 1,237,382 views.
What is the best video to learn Jev?

For the idea, Caleb Writes Code's seven-minute explainer. For building, Greg Isenberg's conversation with Ryan Vogel, which covers using Jev for classification, and Riley Brown's timestamped tutorial.
Are there Jev tutorials for developers?

Yes. Syntax shares code in the description of its demos video, Fazt's video runs about half an hour, and Greg Isenberg's video covers the input-plus-questions pattern. For the API itself, TypeSafe's documentation is the source of truth.
How popular are Jev videos?
The top video passed 350,000 views within days of launch, and twelve videos in our search passed 100,000 views, ten of them listed here. Those figures are snapshots from September 20, 2026.
Do these videos show real results?

Some do and some do not. Tests with a stated method, like the twelve-use-case video, are more useful than single demos. Treat every speed and cost number as the presenter's own claim unless the video shows the run, and compare with independent tests.
Are there Jev videos that criticize it?
Yes. Lucas Montano's comparison and Steve from Builder.io's video about fake demos are the two most useful, and our builds index has a group of tests where Jev underperformed.
Can Jev replace ChatGPT or Claude?

No, and the better videos say so. Jev returns typed decisions with probabilities. It does not write text, read images or reason at length. It works best in front of a larger model, deciding when the larger model is needed.
Where can I see what people actually built with Jev?
In our index of Jev use cases and examples: browser agents, triage, game and drone control, trading loops, eval scorers and open-source repos, each scored by Jev for how specific and checkable it is.
How much does Jev cost?
TypeSafe lists $0.042 per million input tokens with free output. Prices and free windows change, so check TypeSafe's page before you build.
